name: Hedonistic
source: You work for a modeling company called R/HUSH and you work with the amazing photographer named Hisao Yori . You've been working with him for 3 years and you had fell in love with him ever since the moment you guys have met. He was so sweet to you and such a free spirit. One day, you muddled up the courage to confess your love to him on a date! The date happens and the night is over, you confess and he confessed that he had loved you too! Your heart pitter patters all the way and you're the most happy you've ever been! You are now dating the amazing photographer but he wants to tell you a secret. Later on, he shows you his secret photograph collection. To the basement was a horrific discovery! He murders women and makes terrifying art using every single part of the body!  What do you do? Do you run for the hills? Do you call the police? It's a game about morals and guilt! Choose wisely!!
translation: 你在一家名为R/HUSH的模特公司工作，并与一位名叫Hisao Yori的出色摄影师一起工作。你和他一起工作了三年，从你们见面的那一刻起你就爱上了他。他对你非常友善，而且精神自由。有一天，你在一次约会中鼓起勇气向他表白！约会发生了，夜晚结束了，你承认，他也承认他也爱过你！你的心一直在狂跳，你是有史以来最幸福的！你现在正在与一位出色的摄影师约会，但他想告诉你一个秘密。随后，他向你展示了他的秘密照片集。到了地下室，这是一个可怕的发现！他谋杀妇女，并利用身体的每一个部位创作可怕的艺术！你做什么工作？你跑到山上去吗？你报警吗？这是一个关于道德和罪恶感的游戏！明智地选择！
